name: TOB Communication Group
description: A named, admin-curated, reusable list of users — the Communication Center Composer's 'Group' audience type (see communication/groups.py). Deliberately a flat JSON member list (member_user_ids), the same convention TOB Communication Campaign already uses for its own audience_user_ids, rather than a child table — groups are hand-curated and bounded, not a bulk-import mechanism.

fields.label: Member User IDs (JSON)
fields.description: JSON array of user emails. Only Website Users are ever added (see groups.py's _valid_user_ids) — resolved fresh at campaign-creation time via resolve_audience(), same snapshot-once semantics as every other audience type in this app.
